name: candidate-contract-v1
chunk_rule: Sort candidates by product_id within each impression; alternate between two chunks. Deliberately normalize each chunk independently, then merge. This is an injected misuse, not an observed production bug.
removal_rule: Remove the largest product_id from each multi-candidate impression. Do not inspect labels to choose the removed candidate. Recompute normalization on retained candidates.
correct_assembly_rule: Gather the raw scores from both chunks into their original row positions, then normalize once per complete impression.
comparison: Compare exact mean-probability preservation with raw-score mean centering at the existing frozen alpha; do not select a new policy or tune alpha.
scope: Engineering sensitivity audit on previously used development validation. No model training, no original test access, no online lift estimate or production promotion. Candidate removal is not a counterfactual click experiment. No uncertainty-adjusted model-quality conclusion.
